newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba to launch pocket-sized digital camera.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba to launch pocket-sized digital camera.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Monday it would launch the world's thinnest and lightest digital still camera in Japan in August, following its debut in the United States in July.
The pocket-sized PDR-2, to be called the Allegretto in Japan, measures 105mm by 55mm by 20mm and weighs 130 grams, excluding the battery, Toshiba said in a statement.

The product is the first to use a one-quarter inch 330,000-pixel complimentary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) image sensor as the eye, which uses one-10th the power of models with commonly used image sensors, a Toshiba spokesman said.
"By using the CMOS we were able to minimise the size of the camera itself," he said.

The camera uses SmartMedia, a 0.76mm thick removable stamp-sized flash-memory storage card, Toshiba said. A built-in personal computer card allows the camera to be plugged into a computer to download the images, it said.
The Allegretto will be priced at 59,800 yen, and Toshiba expects to sell 7,000 of them a month, it said.
